description: Machine-readable long-term pricing policy for SHEIN ordinary marketing signup, coupon pairing, and limited-discount fallback. This file contains no credentials.

limitedDiscount.priorityNote: Limited discount is the lowest-priority rescue layer: keep ordinary marketing + 15% coupon as the primary price stack; cancel/recreate or adjust limited discounts when they would make the final price lower or higher than the intended target.

exposureTopLinks.sourceNote: Top links are ranked globally per standard_goods_sn across all stores and all links from positive BI storeLinks/links exposure fields. Rows with no positive exposure metric are not used for top-link ranking; if exposure data is unavailable, scripts keep the base margin and mark the exposure rule as not applied.
